const body=$json.body||$json; const oid=String(body.airtable_order_record_id||'').trim(); const pid=String(body.airtable_product_record_id||'').trim(); if(!oid||!pid) throw new Error('Missing airtable_order_record_id or airtable_product_record_id'); return [{json:{airtable_order_record_id:oid, airtable_product_record_id:pid}}];

const order=$('HTTP - Get Assign Order').first().json||{}; const product=$('HTTP - Get Assign Product').first().json||{}; const locResp=$('HTTP - List Locations Assign').first().json||{}; const ship=((locResp.records||[]).find(r=>String(r.fields?.name||'')===String($env.AIRTABLE_SHIPPED_LOCATION_NAME||'Shipped'))||{}).id||''; if(!ship) throw new Error('Could not resolve Shipped location'); const of=order.fields||{}; const pf=product.fields||{}; const existing=Array.isArray(of.products)?of.products:[]; if(existing.includes(product.id)) throw new Error('Product already linked to this order'); const locs=Array.isArray(pf.storage_location)?pf.storage_location:[]; if(locs.includes(ship)) throw new Error('Product is already marked Shipped'); return [{json:{order_record_id:order.id, product_record_id:product.id, order_fields:{products:[...existing, product.id]}, product_fields:{storage_location:[ship]}, result:{ok:true, order_record_id:order.id, product_record_id:product.id, order_ref:String(of.order_code||of.ecwid_order_id||of.order_number||''), product_id:pf.product_id||'', message:'Product linked to order and marked shipped.'}}}];
return [{ json: { ok: true, page_count: 0, raw_record_count: 0, products: [], count: 0, skipped: true, message: 'Type at least 2 characters to search products.' } }];
